info.title: Microsoft-Decision-1.1
info.description: Evaluate text, JSON, and images against yes/no, choice, and score questions with the Microsoft-Decision-1.1 model deployed in Microsoft Foundry. Answers are exposed as named, typed outputs that the connector derives from your questions.

post.description: Sends a state, optional images, and a set of questions to the Microsoft-Decision-1.1 deployment of the connection and returns typed answers. The output fields are generated from the questions.

default.description: The request failed. The body contains the Foundry or connector error.

post.description: Runs the same evaluation and returns the native decision response as JSON text. Use it when your flow parses the response itself.

200.description: The native decision response serialized as JSON text.

default.description: The request failed. The body contains the Foundry or connector error.

post.description: Builds the answer schema for a question definition inside the connector. No request is sent to Foundry.

state.description: The text to evaluate. Text that is a JSON object or array is sent as structured JSON, so questions can refer to its fields. Refer to an image as image:<name>; images that are not referenced anywhere are added to the end of text state.

questions.description: One row per question. Switch to the entire-array input to pass the rows, or a native questions object keyed by question ID, from an expression.

images.description: Optional still PNG or JPEG images, 280 to 1568 pixels per side and at most 16 MiB each. Refer to an image as image:<name> in the state, instructions, or criteria; unreferenced images are added to the end of text state. Switch to the entire-array input to pass the rows, or a native assets object keyed by image name, from an expression.

id.description: Unique key for the answer, for example is_urgent.

type.description: noul answers yes or no with a probability, choice selects one option, and score rates against ordered levels. Fill in only the fields for the selected type.

instructions.description: The question to ask about the state. Can refer to an image as image:<name>.

noulTrue.description: Noul only. Optional description of a yes answer.

noulFalse.description: Noul only. Optional description of a no answer.

options.description: Choice only. 2 to 255 options with unique keys.

levels.description: Score only. 2 to 10 ordered level descriptions, starting with score 0.

option.description: The value returned when this option is chosen, for example billing.

description.description: Optional description of when to choose this option. Can refer to an image as image:<name>.

name.description: Unique name used to refer to the image as image:<name>, for example photo.png. Letters, digits, '.', '_', and '-' only.

content.description: The image file content, for example from Get file content, or base64 text.

format.description: Optional. Detected from the content when empty.

responseJson.description: The native decision response with model, answers, and usage, as JSON text.

schema.description: JSON schema of the evaluation response.
